title: Stir-Fried Bitter Kale Delight
description: A quick and nutritious Chinese-inspired dish made with bitter kale and a hint of delight.

ingredients.name: Bitter Kale
ingredients.amount: 2 cups, stems removed and discarded, leaves chopped

ingredients.name: Delight (likely referring to Delicata squash or a sweet winter squash)
ingredients.notes: Use a sweet winter squash for best flavor

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped kale and cook until wilted, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced Delight to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
